title: Heatwave = Pool Time
description:
Today's forecast: High temps with a chance of pool time! ☀️ Cool off at a City of San Diego pool. A single visit pass is $5 for adults (16+) and $2.25 for children/disabled/seniors (62+).
Children under 4 years of age must wear a swim diaper, and please do not bring any glass bottles or containers. 

Please check with your local recreation center before heading out, as some facilities are currently closed for renovations: sandiego.gov/pools

#SanDiego #Pool #FindYourHappySpace #heat
